items.summary: On the afternoon of August 17, 2026, officials from the Gujarat police conducted parallel searches at two homes of journalist Ravi Nair in Kerala and Delhi. They seized two of Ravi’s mobile phones from his residence in Kerala. At Ravi’s Delhi residence, law enforcement officials took his son’s laptop, as well as the laptop and iPad of a colleague who was present there. items.summary: Men's jewellery has changed quite a bit in recent years. Rings are no longer reserved for weddings, religious traditions or special occasions. From Instagram styling reels to streetwear looks, a silver ring for men has become an easy way to add personality to an outfit. A simple band can make a basic T-shirt look more put together, while a chunky or textured ring can become the statement piece. The shift is easy to spot, and GIVA has plenty of designs for men who want to try the trend in their own way. Whether you're buying your first ring, looking for a gift or adding another piece to your collection, the real question is, which style is right for you? Why Are Silver Rings So Popular With Men? The appeal is pretty simple. Silver works with almost everything. You can wear a ring with jeans and a T-shirt, a crisp shirt, a kurta or even a wedding outfit. There is also plenty of room to experiment. Some men prefer a barely-there band, while others like wide, oxidised or sculptural designs. You don't have to follow a particular rule. Your wardrobe and personality can do most of the deciding. Why Choose 925 Sterling Silver? You'll often come across 925 sterling silver when shopping for men's jewellery. The 925 mark means the material contains 92.5% pure silver, with other metals added to give it the strength needed for jewellery. This makes it a popular choice for rings, especially if you want something you can wear regularly. Popular Silver Ring Styles for Men 1. Plain Silver Band If you’re new to rings, a simple silver band is a great option. The simple design is a perfect match for everyday wear, whether it’s a pair of jeans and a T-shirt or a casual shirt. 2. Signet Ring A signet ring has a classic feel with a little more personality. It works well for special occasions, milestones or simply when you want a ring that stands out without being too flashy. 3. Oxidised Silver Ring An oxidized silver ring can be quite an interesting choice if you are looking for ethnic, vintage or creative looks. The darker shade of the finish gives the design a rugged character and goes really well with kurtas and relaxed outfits. 4. Gemstone Ring Want something that catches the eye? A gemstone ring adds colour and character to your look. Choose a design with a stone that complements your personal style and wear it as a statement piece. 5. items.summary: Managing several loan repayments at the same time can become challenging, particularly when each loan has a different EMI, repayment date and borrowing cost. A debt consolidation loan allows eligible borrowers to combine multiple outstanding loans into a single loan, making repayments easier to manage. However, the best consolidation loan is not simply the one with the lowest advertised personal loan interest rate . It is the loan that reduces the overall borrowing burden while offering repayment terms that suit the borrower's financial situation. What makes a debt consolidation loan the best choice? The best debt consolidation loan is one that helps simplify repayments without increasing the total cost of borrowing. Which lenders should borrowers compare? When consolidating multiple loans, compare lenders that offer a sufficient loan amount at a lower overall borrowing cost. A low advertised starting rate helps screen options but does not represent the rate every applicant will receive. Two applicants approaching the same lender may receive different loan offers because each application undergoes an individual credit assessment. Lenders generally evaluate: ● Credit history ● Monthly income ● Existing financial commitments ● Employment stability ● Repayment capacity These factors help determine the applicable personal loan interest rate and the final borrowing terms.
